rules:
use transparent, measurable rules (reported with each case) and are confirmed by visual review:
  similar_generation  wrong class with the same make+model text, different year/variant
  detector_miss       no detection with IoU >= 0.5 (or best IoU < 0.5)
  low_resolution      ground-truth box shorter side < 120 px
  lighting            ROI mean luminance < 60 or > 200
  viewpoint           box aspect ratio w/h < 1.15 (near-frontal / rear view)
  occlusion_truncation  GT box touches the image border (vehicle cut off) - truncation proxy for occlusion

cases.diagnosis: rule-based category 'similar_generation'; high-confidence error | visual review: Side view of a pickup; Crew Cab (2010) vs Quad Cab (2009) differ mainly in rear-door size - a genuinely fine distinction between near-identical generations.
cases.proposed_improvement: higher input resolution / part-focused crops (grille, lights) or fine-grained attention; more examples of the confusable pair
cases.visual_review: Side view of a pickup; Crew Cab (2010) vs Quad Cab (2009) differ mainly in rear-door size - a genuinely fine distinction between near-identical generations.

cases.diagnosis: rule-based category 'similar_generation'; high-confidence error | visual review: Straight frontal view: the Accord Coupe and Sedan share almost the same front end; the body-style cue (door count, roofline) is not visible from this angle.
cases.proposed_improvement: higher input resolution / part-focused crops (grille, lights) or fine-grained attention; more examples of the confusable pair

cases.diagnosis: rule-based category 'detector_miss'; detector failure | visual review: Composite marketing photo showing two views of the same car; the ground-truth box spans both, the detector boxes one car (IoU 0.29). Annotation convention, not a missed vehicle; classification on the GT crop is correct.
cases.proposed_improvement: lower detector threshold with user confirmation, or train with more small/occluded vehicles
